asset.content: combined whole-aircraft AR derivative, 100k faces, 2048px textures, 1 mesh / 1 node / 2 textures
asset.museum_object: Smithsonian NASM A19610048000 (the original 1903 Wright Flyer)

confirmations: Smithsonian's official Sketchfab upload of this model states 'CC0 Public Domain' (creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): 'copy, modify, and distribute this work without contacting the Smithsonian'
si.edu object record nasm_A19610048000: 'restrictions and rights marked as CC0... This media is in the public domain (free of copyright restrictions)... The metadata usage is also CC0'
the 3d.si.edu object is served under the open_access EDAN facet (the Smithsonian Open Access corpus is CC0 by definition)
license.caveat: the Voyager scene document.json carries a boilerplate generator field '(c) Smithsonian Institution. All rights reserved.' — that is the Voyager document-format asset header present on all scenes, NOT the object's media license; the EDAN Open Access designation and the official CC0 statement govern. No 'Usage Conditions Apply' flag exists for this object.
license.in_app_attribution: Attribution not legally required under CC0; the app credits 'Smithsonian Institution, National Air and Space Museum (CC0)' as a courtesy and for provenance display (plan: provenance recorded in-app).

role_boundary.visual_only: this scan is the PRESENTATION mesh (PresentationId ingredient). It is exhibit-scale: usable for envelope/proportion sanity, NEVER as a source of section geometry, hinge locations, or any physics-bearing dimension — those come from the E1 dossiers (prop-geometry-v1 records the same rule for blades).
role_boundary.physics_binding: E2.2's rig binds this visual to the FlyerDesign schema (E3.1); dimension mismatches between scan and dossier values are RESOLVED IN FAVOR OF THE DOSSIERS and recorded, never silently scaled away.

alternatives_ranked.source: same model via Smithsonian official Sketchfab (CC0, download enabled)
higher-res per-part GLB/OBJ derivatives from the same 3d-api CDN (engine/filler/wings, up to ~3.9 MB per part)

alternatives_ranked.use: fallback if Smithsonian access ever regresses
only if all free-license paths fail (fallback decision recorded per DONE-WHEN; NOT needed)

loader_note: draco-compressed: the three.js pipeline must register DRACOLoader (E2.2); Blender imports natively.
no_claims: License and provenance registry for one presentation asset. No geometric fidelity claim beyond 'exhibit-scale scan of the original artifact'.
